The same guard also runs before filler startup.

PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v test_bootstrap.py test_runtime_guard.py test_inner_command.py: 4 PASS. Inner test mutates guard, config, closure, verifier, manifest or interpreter symlink after the first check; Python execution marker remains absent.

Native selection requires stop=true, stop_type eos/word, truncated=false and strict in-range single digit; grant guard checks active UTC window, deadline, row path, STOP path and CPU affinity. Mapped ggml/llama/mtmd checked against production manifest; copied linkage checker included in closure.
